required_general_rule.name: instance_collection_registration_dispatch
activate_callback_only_when: a reached registrar stores the exact callback argument into a concrete collection/field/map on a concrete registry receiver
a reached dispatcher reads the same storage object and invokes an implemented callback method on the retrieved value
registration precedes dispatch on the same registry instance
virtual/interface dispatch selects methods implemented by the concrete stored callback type
required_general_rule.propagation: carry callback object identity through add/put or field assignment, iterator/array/map retrieval, cast, and interface invoke; preserve registry receiver and storage-field identity
required_general_rule.conditionality: retain branch, null, contains/dedup, removal/replacement, PatchRedirector, and asynchronous data availability as conditions/unknowns
forbidden_shortcuts: do not execute a callback merely because its constructor was reached
do not merge registries by collection type or callback interface
do not treat Pair.second or an Activity/context argument as callback registration
do not infer later model selection solely from onPageCreateView

positive: Activity creates one registry R and callback C; R.register(C) stores C in R.callbacks; R.dispatch iterates R.callbacks and calls C.onPageCreateView; C reaches a WebView capability: capability must be attributed to Activity
C is returned in Pair.second as well as registered; deduplicate by object identity and emit the capability once
two concrete callback implementations behind an interface are registered into distinct registry instances; only the instance whose dispatch is reached may execute
negative: construct C near register/dispatch but never pass C to register: emit no capability from C
store C in registry R1 but dispatch R2: emit no capability from C
construct/register C but remove the same C before the only dispatch on all known branches: do not execute it
construct C and put it only in Pair.second or an ordinary presenter field: do not treat that storage as an event registration
registered callback initializes a player but model list is empty or selected index invalid: do not unconditionally execute the selection suffix
